question: Can the R1 pad ring be rebuilt at 1700 um (D10 amendment) with the same 24 IO cells, no odd filler gap, and pass the checks of revision c?
answer: Yes. Pitch 142 um (IO cell gap 62 um, corner gap 134 um, both even), 152 IO fillers, no Filler200. Main, maximal, precheck DRC and density: 0 items. G1-form LVS fails as in revisions a and c (210/261 devices, 59/119 nets). Canonical LVS: not run.
